Me?

lines.text: I agree with Anis and Neon.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: As long as it's something you've decided, then I won't have any complaints.

lines.text: I'm all for Old-Timer deciding too.

How about we all meet together?

It's not that...

lines.text: Never mind.
